dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible macro-annuli exhibit dark, high-contrast perimeters with an irregular circular geometry, transitioning via a soft gradient into lighter gray centers. The most prominent three structures are located in the central dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, asymmetrical light-gray blobs without internal gradients, clustered primarily along the upper-mid dorsal ridge and extending towards the posterior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle across the mid-lateral surface, with the widest angle positioned at the most dorsal keypoint.
